product_metadata.title: Airhead Plush Air Mattress with Built-in Pump and Manual Valve – Double Height Comfort for Home or Camping
features: Double Height: Comfortable air mattress with 18” Inflated height. 2” longer and constructed with thicker materials
Warranty: Comes with a one year manufacturer’s limited warranty
Built in Pump: Includes built-in pump for easy inflation and deflation
Speed Safety Value: Manual valve allows the mattress to be inflated outdoors or during power outages
Carry Bag: Includes convenient carry bag for storage and transport
description: Treat yourself or your guests to a great night’s sleep. We specially engineered a series of air channels within our airbed design and a soft plush flocked top surface that results in soft, plush, comfortable sleep experience. The mattress features a double height 18 inches of clearance from the floor for comfort. Your Airhead air mattress utilizes two methods to inflate the bed. Inflate using the built-in pump or if you don’t have access to an electrical outlet, use the secondary valve to inflate with a hand-pump. Perfect for Guests or Camping. An included cord storage system keeps the cords stored when not in use. Your Airhead Plush Airbed is made from virgin PVC so there are no imperfections and is extra thick to enhance its durability. A carry bag is included to easily store your twin airbed away.
